title: Real World English
summary: 旅行、社交、听说读写综合实战与阶段验收。
objectives: Combine travel and social communication skills
Use time, prices and evidence to choose a plan
Complete an integrated listening, reading, speaking and writing task

lessons.title: Arrive and Adapt
lessons.subtitle: 处理列车取消并确认新行程
grammar: 用礼貌确认句与条件句整理方案

listening.title: Arrive and Adapt
listening.transcript: The ten o’clock train is cancelled. Your ticket is valid on the 10:40 train. If you prefer, there’s a replacement bus at 10:20 from the main entrance. The bus takes ninety minutes.

questions.q: When does the replacement bus leave?

followUp.title: Listen to an announcement
followUp.transcript: This is a message about Monday’s visitor briefing at the tourist office. It begins at 13 fifteen in the River Room and lasts 25 minutes. Admission costs 4 pounds and there are 18 places. Please come in through the north entrance and ask for Eli. You will receive a map. Please bring a pencil.

questions.q: On which day does the event take place?
What time does the event begin?
What are visitors asked to bring?

speaking.prompt: 选择列车或巴士，向旅伴说明时间和抵达酒店后的安排。
speaking.sample: Let’s take the 10:40 train. We’ll reach the hotel at about 11:45 and wait in the lobby.

你的同伴没听清刚才的活动通知。用自己的话复述日期、房间和费用。
同伴无法按时到达 visitor briefing。告诉对方你会怎么办，并询问对方是否同意。
checklist: 用问句确认对方是否同意

reading.title: 处理列车取消并确认新行程
reading.text: The 10:40 train arrives at 11:30. Hotel luggage storage opens at noon. It takes fifteen minutes to walk from the station to the hotel. Guests can use the lobby while they wait.

followUp.title: Read the booking notice
followUp.text: Visitor briefing booking notice. Book online before 12:00. Collect your ticket at the tourist office information desk. Payment is by card. Changes are free until Friday. If you arrive late, wait by the entrance until a member of staff comes to meet you.

questions.q: When is the online booking deadline?
Where do you collect your ticket?
